newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp to sell natgas gathering assets.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp to sell natgas gathering assets.

text.p: PacifiCorp announced Wednesday plans to sell the natural gas gathering and processing asssets of TPC Corp, a wholly-owned subsidiary it acquired in April.
Portland, Ore.-based PacifiCorp said the offer includes the largest gas gathering system along the Texas gulf coast, with a total capacity of 1.68 billion cubic feet per day.
"We remain committed to TPC as a business unit of PacifiCorp," said Don Furman, vice president of domestic business development, in a statement.
But he ntoed the gathering and processing assets are not part of the company's plan for marketing all forms of energy to wholesale customers throughout the U.S. and abroad.
PacifiCorp announced last month plans to acquire Britain's Energy Group Plc for $9.6 billion.
